notes: EntryPoint.sol: handleOps/handleAggregatedOps are the only state-changing entry points; both guarded by nonReentrant (tx.origin==msg.sender EOA, no code). Validation phase (_validatePrepayment) runs fully before any execution; any FailedOp reverts the whole bundle tx.

EntryPoint.sol: _validatePrepayment copies op to memory, hashes via getUserOpHash (EIP-712), enforces all gas values <= uint120 (AA94), computes prefund, validates account (create-if-needed, validateUserOp, decrement deposit), updates nonce (AA25), enforces verificationGasLimit (AA26), then paymaster validation (deposit decrement first, AA31/AA33/AA35/AA36).

EntryPoint.sol: _executeUserOp wraps execution in a self-call to innerHandleOp; inner OOG marker (INNER_OUT_OF_GAS) aborts the bundle (AA95); INNER_REVERT_LOW_PREFUND charges the full prefund. _postExecution charges actual gas + 10% unused-gas penalties, refunds the rest to sender/paymaster deposit, calls paymaster postOp only on non-empty context.
EntryPoint.sol: _callValidatePaymasterUserOp parses returndata by hand in assembly; AA35 size check is computed in an unchecked block (see BUG-1).

StakeManager.sol: deposits/stakes in one mapping; CEI order correct in withdrawStake/withdrawTo (state zeroed before external call). addStake requires non-decreasing unstakeDelaySec and stake <= uint112.max.
NonceManager.sol: 192-bit key + 64-bit sequence; _validateAndUpdateNonce post-increments and compares; incrementNonce is caller-scoped (msg.sender).

UserOperationLib.sol: paymaster signature suffix scheme (magic 0x22e325a297439656 + uint16 length) is deliberately excluded from the userOpHash; getPaymasterSignatureLength reverts on oversized length fields.
Eip7702Support.sol: 7702 initCode marker 0x7702 in first 20 bytes; delegate extracted from 23-byte 0xef0100-prefixed code; hash override replaces initCode hash with keccak(delegate[, initCallData]).

EntryPointSimulations.sol: never deployed on-chain; eth_call-only. senderCreator() recomputes the CREATE address; domain separator re-initialized per simulation from storage. simulateValidation returns stake info for sender/factory/paymaster/aggregator.
Exec.sol: thin assembly call/staticcall/delegatecall wrappers; getReturnData caps at maxLen (0 = full).

Trust boundaries: bundler (untrusted, chooses ops/order/beneficiary) vs accounts/paymasters/factories/aggregators (untrusted code, gas-bounded, deposit-backed) vs EntryPoint accounting (deposits mapping is the money). All untrusted calls are gas-bounded except aggregator.validateSignatures in handleAggregatedOps (no explicit gas cap; mitigated by ERC-7562 staking/reputation, see killed lead K-3).
